theme: An open day on the road, a few bookings quietly going stale.
greeting: The calendar is empty today, Dan — just an overnight in Fredericksburg. The day is yours; the pressure is on two holiday bookings that have slipped past their dates.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A p1 Todoist task now about five weeks past its date. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market — thin inventory, holiday pricing, and it sells out. A refundable hold costs nothing and takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by (Sept 30) and book-by (Oct 15) have both passed. Six people, three weeks, over the holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year — pick domestic vs. international, then lock a shortlist of three.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week window for driving the Pathfinder Portland → St Pete has now passed. If it didn't happen, the plan and the rental math behind it need a rethink.
